$comment: Generated from ArchiveManifest in src/archive/types.ts by `pnpm schema:update`; don't edit. reeval-archive.json, the last entry of a history archive: a run's <runId>.zip.
title: ArchiveManifest

ArchiveFile.description: One file in an archive, by its path from the archive's root.

path.description: Relative to the archive's root, with `/`: `<runId>.json` or under `<runId>/`.

ArchiveManifest.description: The manifest of a history archive: a zip of one recorded run, laid out as the run is in a history folder. A `run` archive holds the record, `<runId>.json`, and the files beside it under `<runId>/`; a `debug` archive holds the run's debug data under `<runId>/`, as `.reeval/debug/<runId>/` keeps it. The manifest is the zip's last entry and lists every other.

contents.description: What the archive holds: the recorded run, or its debug data.

debugLevel.description: Of a `debug` archive: which of each attempt's debug files it holds, as `history.debug` names them.

files.description: Every other entry, sorted by path.

revision.description: 1 for a run's first archive, one more each time it's written again: only a resume or `--retry-errors` replacing the record writes it again.
